posts.title: cf-HumanNameParser: Parsing People's Names in CFML Without a Jar
posts.description: A CFML port of java HumanNameParser. Splits a person's name into salutation, leading initial, first name, nicknames, middle names, last name, suffix, and postnominal. One component, no jar. Runs on Adobe ColdFusion 2016+, Lucee 5+, and BoxLang.

posts.title: cf-yourls: A ColdFusion component for the YOURLS URL shortener API
posts.description: cf-yourls: CFML wrapper for the YOURLS link shortener API. Shorten URLs, expand keywords, pull click stats, and manage Expiry plugin rules from Adobe ColdFusion 2016+ or Lucee 6. Signature or username/password auth, 61 TestBox specs, MIT.

posts.title: cfSlack: A ColdFusion Component for the Slack Web API
posts.description: A new ColdFusion component for the Slack Web API - wrapping 50 methods across chat, conversations, users, views, and DND, tested on seven engines from Adobe ColdFusion 2016 through 2025 and Lucee 5 & 6.
